title: Storyboard-to-video sequence
when_to_use: Use when a Seedance video task requires storyboard-to-video sequence; this candidate is for explicit inspection only.
method: Write an image-generation storyboard sheet with numbered panels, framing, action and total runtime. Audit its order and character consistency. Convert it to a concise video instruction that maps one panel to one temporal stage without skipped or reordered panels.
failure_modes: prompt accidentally recreates the storyboard layout as a static image.
verification: Candidate; no real Seedance output validation. Do not auto-activate.
